summary: New 8-criterion briefing (Work Orders dedup/filters/status-column, PO-slash detail nav, WO file download, Bills payment timeline, Documents role-based actions, Admin Sync Log tab, vendor login). Fixed a stale pre-existing backend test (test_tscheck_sync_idempotent.py hardcoded 1 vendor/order/bill from an older seed; current seed is 12/3/3 per briefing seed_facts) so the full backend suite is green again. Added 4 new backend test files (work-orders dedup+download, admin sync log, documents role access) and 8 new browser checks, one per matrix criterion (vendor login reused an existing passing check). All 8 UI criteria and all backend tests pass; no application bugs found.

checks.criterion: Vendor login works with vendor code as both id and password
checks.name: vendor-login-dashboard-kpis
checks.evidence: Re-ran pre-existing check: AE0001JV2627/AE0001JV2627 (and lowercase variant) reaches /dashboard with all 4 KPI tiles populated; wrong password stays on /login with an error toast.

checks.criterion: Work Orders list shows one row per PO number with filter counts and a summary line
checks.name: work-orders-dedup-filters-summary
checks.evidence: As admin on /work-orders: 3 rows with distinct PO numbers, filters read All (3)/Active (3)/Completed (0)/On Hold (0); clicking Completed shows 0 rows and summary text containing '0 work order' and '0.00'.

checks.criterion: Work Orders list has one row per PO number (backend dedup + downloadable file)
checks.name: test_tscheck_work_orders_dedup_and_download.py
checks.evidence: GET /work-orders as vendor -> po_number values unique, includes 'P00020'. GET /work-orders/{id}/po-file for P00020 -> 200, application/pdf, non-empty body. GET .../po-file for a WO without has_po_file -> 404 'No purchase order file on the workflow portal'.

checks.criterion: Work order status column shows only the upstream auto status text under the badge
checks.name: work-order-status-column-single-line
checks.evidence: Admin /work-orders: no 'Next:' text anywhere; each of the 3 status cells has <=2 lines of text and none contain a lone em-dash placeholder.

checks.criterion: Clicking a PO number opens the work order detail page and does not log the user out
checks.name: work-order-po-slash-detail-navigation
checks.evidence: Clicked the PO link containing '/' (A/E/Febrication/008/2025) -> navigated to /work-orders/<id>, PO number text and BOQ table (work-order-items-table) visible; sidebar-user-name still shows 'Arun Enterprises' (not logged out).

checks.criterion: Work Orders 'Work Order' action downloads the original uploaded file; disabled when absent
checks.name: work-order-download-button-file-availability
checks.evidence: Vendor row P00020: download-work-order-P00020 button enabled, click triggers a real browser download with a .pdf filename. Admin row A/E/Febrication/008/2025 (no uploaded file): button is disabled, not erroring.

checks.criterion: Admin Sync Log lists recent sync runs (backend)
checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_sync_log.py
checks.evidence: GET /sync/runs as admin -> 200, >=1 run with synced_at + vendors/work_orders/bills keys. GET /sync/runs as vendor -> 403.

checks.criterion: Bills page bill detail dialog shows the payment timeline
checks.name: bill-detail-payment-timeline
checks.evidence: As vendor, clicking bill-row-BILL00042627 opens bill-detail-panel containing 'Payment Timeline' heading and payment-timeline with 5 dated payment-timeline-step-* entries.

checks.criterion: Documents: vendor can upload but cannot download or delete
checks.name: documents-vendor-upload-no-download-delete
checks.evidence: Vendor /documents: upload form visible with exactly 7 doc-type options and a '100 KB' size hint; documents table has 0 document-download-* and 0 document-delete-* buttons.

checks.criterion: Documents: admin sees vendor identity column and can download
checks.name: documents-admin-vendor-column-and-download
checks.evidence: Admin /documents table shows document-vendor-* column per row; clicking document-download-* triggers a real file download.

checks.criterion: Documents role access (backend): vendor upload allowed, download/delete forbidden; admin download allowed and sees vendor identity
checks.name: test_tscheck_documents_role_access.py
checks.evidence: Vendor POST /documents (fixture tscheck-doc-role-fixture) -> 200; vendor GET .../download -> 403; vendor DELETE ... -> 403. Admin GET /documents shows vendor_code='AE0001JV2627' for that doc; admin GET .../download -> 200 non-empty body; admin then deletes its own fixture. Vendor POST with disallowed doc_type 'Passport' -> 400.

checks.criterion: Admin Sync Log tab lists recent sync runs (UI)
checks.name: admin-sync-log-tab-shows-runs
checks.evidence: Admin Command Center -> Sync Log tab: admin-sync-log-table visible with at least one non-empty row (run timestamp + vendors/work orders/bills counts).

action_items: Fixed a stale pre-existing backend test (test_tscheck_sync_idempotent.py) whose hardcoded counts (1/1/1) no longer matched the current seed data (12 vendors/3 work orders/3 bills); updated to assert idempotency generically. Not an application bug - a test-data drift from an earlier iteration.
